name: bios-implant
description: Agent University BIOS and worldmodel plugin for Codex with portable skills and a local companion MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Portable BIOS Implant skills plus a local companion MCP for Codex.
interface.longDescription: BIOS Implant delivers Agent University skills for install, connect, boot, and doctor flows, plus the local companion MCP used for folder binding, staging, and health checks.
capabilities: Portable install, connect, boot, and doctor skills
Local companion MCP for folder binding and BIOS staging
Installer-managed remote implant access through native Codex MCP
interface.defaultPrompt: Run the doctor skill and summarize BIOS Implant health. If installation is healthy, use the boot skill for this workspace.
